patch_checks.why: informed blind fix (instruction+code+traps, no tests), in-container verified

wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the protected object is the single SCM operation itself; there is no neighbouring or proxy resource whose authorisation could be substituted, so a wrong-resource fix has no distinct shape here
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the decision is a boolean gate on the caller-supplied token before any normalising or defaulting step; no test path normalises the attacker value ahead of the decision
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: there is no authority lookup whose empty answer could fail open; with the setting enabled the guard refuses before the credential source is consulted, and a missing integration token is itself a client error
